stemMd: No item requiring refrigeration is stored in the dry cupboard. Every opened jar of this sauce requires refrigeration. Hence no opened jar of this sauce is stored in the dry cupboard. Which parallels the reasoning?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every paid invoice is filed. This invoice is filed, so it is paid.

options.label: B
options.textMd: No confidential file is on the public server. Every personnel record is confidential. Hence no personnel record is on the public server.

options.label: C
options.textMd: All steel tools are metal. This tool is not steel, so it is not metal.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some flowers are fragrant. All roses are flowers, so all roses are fragrant.

options.label: E
options.textMd: No swimmer is absent. Some absent people are runners, so no runner is a swimmer.

explanationMd: The conclusion transfers an exclusion to a subclass. Opened sauce jars belong to the refrigerated class, just as personnel records belong to the confidential class. Both classes are excluded from the specified storage location.

distractorRationale.d: A partial property is extended to every member of a subclass.
distractorRationale.e: A claim about some runners becomes a claim about all.
